description: This file defines the internal structures, macros, and function prototypes related to the Lua interpreter's global and thread state management, including garbage collection, call information, and stack handling.

methods.name: luaE_newthread
methods.description: Creates a new Lua thread (coroutine) from the given Lua state.

methods.name: luaE_freethread
methods.description: Frees a Lua thread previously created.
